```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}

activation_names <- c("sigmoid", "sigmoid_more")

for (activation in activation_names) {
  
  # Read the corresponding CSV
  path <- paste0(
    "neuralbandit3_original_metrics_",
    activation,
    ".csv"
  )
  
  metrics <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  # Calculate recovery signals
  metrics <- metrics %>%
    arrange(step) %>%
    mutate(
      drift_event = as.logical(drift_event),
      reward_change = rolling_reward - lag(rolling_reward),
      increasing = reward_change > 0,
      recovery_signal = increasing &
        lag(increasing, 1, default = FALSE) &
        lag(increasing, 2, default = FALSE)
    )
  
  # Identify concept drift points
  drift_points <- metrics %>%
    filter(drift_event == TRUE) %>%
    pull(step) %>%
    sort()
  
  # Initialize recovery results
  recovery_points <- data.frame()
  
  # Identify recovery after each drift
  for (j in seq_along(drift_points)) {
    d <- drift_points[j]
    # Stop searching at the next drift
    if (j < length(drift_points)) {
      next_drift <- drift_points[j + 1]
    } else {
      next_drift <- Inf
    }
    
    recovery <- metrics %>%
      filter(
        step > d,
        step < next_drift,
        drift_event == FALSE,
        recovery_signal == TRUE
      ) %>%
      slice(1)
    
    if (nrow(recovery) > 0) {
      recovery_points <- bind_rows(
        recovery_points,
        data.frame(
          drift_step = d,
          recovery_step = recovery$step,
          rolling_reward = recovery$rolling_reward
        )
      )
    }
  }
  
  # Calculate recovery time
  recovery_points <- recovery_points %>%
    mutate(
      recovery_time = recovery_step - drift_step
    )
  
  print(paste("Activation:", activation))
  print(recovery_points)
  
  # Create graph
  gg_graph <- ggplot(metrics, aes(x = step, y = rolling_reward)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    # Concept drift
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = drift_points,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "red",
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    # Recovery begins
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = recovery_points$recovery_step,
      linetype = "dotted",
      color = "blue",
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "NeuralBandit3: Rolling Reward - ",
        activation
      ),
      subtitle = "Red = concept drift | Blue = detected recovery",
      x = "Training Steps",
      y = "Rolling Reward"
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 1),
      labels = scales::percent
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  print(gg_graph)
}
```
